values.note: Campspot, 1 night 2027-06-15 (Tue), 2 adults: 30-amp partial hookup (water/electric) $89; full-hookup sites $94 (Oct 2026: $87/$92). The park's own rates page (undated) says $84 water/electric and $89 full hookups plus tax, $5 per extra person over two, weekly $462/$490, winter (Oct-Apr) monthly $750/$800 plus electric, no summer monthly rates. Dry camp sites with no amenities $54 and a 20-ft truck-camper site $64 are not counted in the base.

fees.source: https://www.campspot.com/book/whitefishrvpark/search/2027-06-15/2027-06-16/guests0,2,0 ('30 Amp Partial Hookup RV Site ... $89.00 Avg per night'; '30/50 Amp Full Hookup Pull Through RV Site ... $94.00') + https://whitefishrvpark.com/rv-camping-site-rates/ ('Full hook-ups (water, sewer, electric) $89.00 per night plus tax', 'Partial hook-ups (water, electric) $84.00 per night plus tax'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://whitefishrvpark.com/ ('51 Full Hookup Sites', '50 amp sites available') + Campspot site types ('30/50 Amp Full Hookup ...'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Home page says 51 full-hookup sites and 14 pull-throughs; Campspot sells 35 RV sites (13 pull-throughs up to 45 ft, back-ins 25-40 ft, partial-hookup sites up to 35 ft) plus 5 dry camp sites.

sites.source: https://whitefishrvpark.com/ ('14 Pull-Throughs') + Campspot ('30/50 Amp Full Hookup Pull Through RV Site Fits vehicles up to 45 feet long'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: No open campfires; self-contained fire pits allowed.

facilities.source: https://whitefishrvpark.com/ ('Free Wi-Fi', 'Dump Station', 'Laundry Facilities', 'Immaculate Restrooms & Showers') + rates page ('No open campfires in park'), read 2026-10-22

season.source: https://whitefishrvpark.com/ ('Enjoy Year-Round Recreation'; 'Winter Rates: Daily Rate starting at $84') + rates page ('Winter ( October through April)' monthly rates), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Book on Campspot ('Book Now!') or by phone; no reservations by email.

booking.source: https://whitefishrvpark.com/ ('Book Now!' -> campspot.com/book/whitefishrvpark) + https://whitefishrvpark.com/contact-us/ ('Please call the RV Park to make a reservation: 406-862-7275'), read 2026-10-22

note: RV park within Whitefish city limits on a wooded lot behind the strip mall off US-93 South (shares a sign with Local's Monthly). --Claude
summary: Confirmed on whitefishrvpark.com and its Campspot page: water and sewer, phone 406-862-7275. Added $89-94 (Campspot, mid-June 2027), 50-amp, 45-ft pull-throughs, showers/dump/laundry/Wi-Fi, year-round (winter rates), Campspot booking. Not stated: Good Sam/military (derived values left). Note trimmed of the old $84/$89 prices and the rating line.
flags: Price gate: base $89/night (30-amp water/electric, Campspot mid-June 2027) is over US$50; the Glacier NP gateway applies (29 km, gateways.py), as the inclusion evidence already says. Takes monthly stays in winter only (Oct-Apr); nightly sites are sold year-round, so not a long-stay park.
